events.title: 1daYs Demo v0.2.01t Bug Fix
events.summary: Hello,We have fixed an issue where differences in how internal coordinate data was interpreted under certain Windows regional settings could cause characters and UI elements to appear in incorrect positions.If you encountered this issue while using an existing save file, we recommend starting the game again from the beginning.We would once again like to thank everyone who reported this bug.https://steamcommunity.com/app/4718050/discussions/0/582807520276632311/Thank you.

events.title: 4. Interactions in 1daYs
events.summary: Hello!In this devlog, I’d like to introduce the basic gameplay and interaction system of 1daYs.As Minsu, players explore various locations around the school and neighborhood, talk to people, look at objects in their surroundings, and search for useful items. When Minsu approaches a character or object he can interact with, the available actions will appear in a menu.The available actions depend on the target and the current situation. events.title: 3. The Students of Class 2-7
events.summary: Hello!In this devlog, I would like to introduce the main characters of Class 2-7.I think being in the same class creates a rather unique kind of relationship. Students cannot choose which class they are assigned to, but sharing a classroom can become one of the strongest connections they form at school.Still, being classmates does not mean everyone knows each other well. events.title: 1. About 1daYs.
events.summary: Hello. Today, as I begin this development diary, I’d like to introduce what kind of game 1daYs is.1daYs is a story-driven adventure game set in a small Korean neighborhood and school.Minsu, an ordinary high school student, goes through a day that seems no different from any other, yet somehow feels a little different. events.title: 1daYs Demo 0.1.615.1t Update
events.summary: 1daYs Demo 0.1.615.1t Update 1. The game language will now be set based on your OS language when launching the game for the first time.This does not apply to users who have already set a language or launched the game in a previous version. Please select your language from the Options menu.This only applies to the currently supported languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.You can change the language from Settings > General > Language.

events.title: The 1daYs demo is now available.
events.summary: The 1daYs demo is now available.Hello, this is velupix. The demo for my first game, 1daYs, is now available.Since this is the first game I am making on my own, there may still be many rough edges, but I am working hard to make it an enjoyable experience.Please try the demo, and look forward to the full version coming in the future!Thank you.
